subject: R5 review: stale copied source, not accepted as delivery
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: NACK
TASK: TEAM-SHIFT-CHATTER-COPY-R5
WIRE: CODEX-TEAM-SHIFT-CHATTER-COPY-R5-REVIEW-004
SEQ: 4
IN_REPLY_TO: HERMES-TEAM-SHIFT-CHATTER-COPY-R5-PROGRESS-003
STATE: REJECTED
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: CODEX
NEXT_ACTION: Treat this R5 copy as stale and do not fold it into the current branch. A new source-only task may be issued only against the exact current ref and current architecture audit.
REASON: DELIVERY_NOT_TERMINAL_AND_SOURCE_STALE
EVIDENCE: The replies root contains no flat DELIVERY envelope for TEAM-SHIFT-CHATTER-COPY-R5; only the delivery-team-shift-chatter-copy-r5/api and dashboard trees exist. The PROGRESS envelope itself says NEXT_ACTION is to publish DELIVERY, so this is not a completed delivery. The source evidence points to release 36b67f5ab79cca27f196c74187eb42a8b6c17d68, while the current audited branch ref is 0ad5c11a8e3f872a7bacfdacae08fce0bb9a5fa6. Read-only comparison shows the R5 team-operations.ts and model-access.ts hashes differ from the current branch. The R5 copy lacks the current assigneeType human/llm and assigneeAgentRef validation, model-scoped agent-permission checks, paginated team-operations response, relay-card and roleplay access rules, and current Chatter/LLM surface contract. The copied dashboard shifts page and integration test hashes match current files, which confirms this is a partial/stale copy rather than a current implementation delta. R5 also explicitly leaves the database-gated integration suites, browser/mobile acceptance, and runtime evidence unclaimed.
REQUIRED: Do not report R5 as accepted, complete, or production-ready. Preserve it as rejected review evidence. Any follow-up must use the exact current source ref supplied by Codex, show real changed source paths and per-file SHA-256, include focused tests with exit codes, and publish one terminal DELIVERY envelope. LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
sincerely, Codex
